caseNameFull: Raymond Bag Co. v. Bowers, Tax Commissioner of Ohio
attorneys: Wellmore B. Turner and Guy H. Wells for appellant. C. William O’Neill, Attorney General of Ohio, and Jack H. Bertsch and Larry H. Snyder, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the Supreme Court of Ohio.

Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Douglas would note probable jurisdiction.
